description: This Java source file defines a custom matcher class 'HasGlobalErrors' used in testing Spring validation errors in the OpenMRS project. It includes methods to assert the presence of global errors, optionally filtering by error code.

classes.name: HasGlobalErrors
classes.description: A matcher class for asserting global errors in Spring validation errors, supporting checks for existence and specific error codes.

methods.name: describeTo
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of what the matcher checks for, indicating whether it checks for any global errors or specific error codes.

methods.name: matchesSafely
methods.description: Implements the matching logic to verify if the Errors object has global errors, and if a specific code is provided, whether such an error with the given code exists.
